name: Active/Active Keycloak deployment
description: Choose the ACM pair, namespace, public endpoint, Vault database secret and database TLS mode. Shared infrastructure is discovered.

spec.question_description: Choose two distinct Ready ACM managed clusters. Inventory is refreshed during template registration and revalidated on every launch.
Choose two distinct Ready ACM managed clusters. Inventory is refreshed during template registration and revalidated on every launch.
Hostname only, without https:// or a path. Must be permitted by the existing Vault issuer and belong to a Cloudflare zone accessible to the shared token.
Public IPv6 address for the selected FQDN. The workflow derives the OPNsense interface and creates an IP alias if absent.
Dedicated namespace, identical on both selected clusters. Use a different namespace for each independent deployment; existing namespaces must be owned by this workflow.
Path relative to KV v2 mount kv, containing host, database, username and password (port 5432). Each independent deployment must use a dedicated database. Do not enter credentials.

enabled: require TLS with trusted certificate and matching hostname; fail if unavailable. disabled: use a non-TLS database connection. Checked after ESO resolves the secret, before starting Keycloak. Public HTTPS is unchanged.
